payload.title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Tactus
payload.description:
**Problem**
Low-priority findings from the Tactus repo audit.

**Evidence / Fix** (checklist)
- [ ] README CLI commands section is incomplete; list all current `tactus` subcommands.
- [ ] Stray files committed at repo root: SPECIFICATION.md.bak, docs_output/, project_backup_pre_migrate/, test_run_inputs.sh (also .kanbus.yml.pre_migrate_old); remove or move.
- [ ] Broken relative links to docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md, CONTROL_LOOP_PHASE1_COMPLETE.md, OMNICHANNEL_HITL_PLAN.md and TOOL_ROADMAP.md; restore the files or remove the links.

**How to verify**
`ls SPECIFICATION.md.bak docs_output project_backup_pre_migrate test_run_inputs.sh` finds nothing; a markdown link checker over README.md and docs/ reports no broken relative links.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
